candidate_policy: retain existing pool plus balanced per-slot coverage enumeration; at least12 up to64 new combinations per rule, budget raised only to longest pool; never use references
scheduler: stable round-robin requests with pending goal rules; request and selected candidates are explicit state
supervision: positive action on a checked attributed route still feasible from state; negative only migrated source-reviewed concrete slot non-applicability; unknown masked; no complement negatives
epoch_selection: fixed last epoch, no heldout tuning
graph: same fact/rule/application/request relations; computational reverse edges not legal inference
encoder: cached frozen V8 E5 vectors; no new text model; composite average of available component vectors
stop: one frozen comparison, no result-driven repair/refit, no push. If no supervised comparisons or no selection headroom report instead of inventing negatives. No generalization claim on exposed eight disputes.
